distribution.summary: Henan; Shaanxi; Shandong; Jiangsu; Jiangxi; Hunan; Sichuan; Fujian; Guangdong; Guangxi; Yunnan; Chongqing; Hainan; Taiwan; Hong Kong
distribution.narrative: Yin et al. (1984), under Dryocoetes luteus, documents Henan (Xinyang), Shaanxi (Shiquan), Jiangsu (Nanjing), Jiangxi (Yiyang), Hunan (Changsha, Qidong, Jianghua, Chengbu), Sichuan (historical Chongqing locality), Fujian (Hua'an), Guangdong (Guangzhou), Guangxi (Yangshuo) and Yunnan (Lijiang, Yongsheng, Simao, Xishuangbanna). Huang et al. (2015) repeats the mainland baseline and additionally lists Chongqing and Hainan; this repetition is not independent field confirmation. Beaver & Liu (2010) reports Taiwan plus broad China regions, without adding province-level records. Lau (2025) supplies secondary Hong Kong checklist evidence. Wang et al. (2023) additionally reported Cyrtogenius luteus damaging black pine in Qingdao, Shandong; the Shandong report is not inferred from the older 1984/2015 syntheses.

host_note: 殷蕙芬等 (1984) and 黄复生等 (2015) provide five Pinus species. Beaver & Liu (2010) additionally reports conifers, especially Pinus, and also Larix, Picea and Cornus; these genera are retained at genus level without conversion to species.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Cyrtogenius luteus (Blandford, 1894).

taxonomic_history.name: Cyrtogenius luteus
taxonomic_history.note: Current accepted name in the integrated taxonomic backbone.

nomenclature_note: The current accepted identity is Cyrtogenius luteus (Blandford, 1894), VSN_2121, Scolytinae: Dryocoetini. 殷蕙芬等 (1984) uses Dryocoetes luteus; 黄复生等 (2015) and Beaver & Liu (2010) use Cyrtogenius luteus. Beaver & Liu examined type material and treated O. formosanus as within the variation of C. luteus.
